description: Main FastAPI application source code for subtitle synchronization, validation, user authentication, and reporting endpoints. Defines API routes, middleware, in-memory data stores, and references to models and processing functions.

classes.name: AuthTokenResponse
classes.description: Response model containing the access token and token type.

classes.name: UploadMediaResponse
classes.description: Response model for media and subtitle uploads, containing media identifier and filename.

classes.name: SyncStatus
classes.description: Model representing the status of a synchronization/validation job, including sync ID, status, and detail.

classes.name: ValidationReport
classes.description: Model representing the validation report results for a sync job.

classes.name: ValidationReportItem
classes.description: Individual validation item within the report, indicating type, pass/fail, and details.

classes.name: DashboardSummary
classes.description: Summary object listing all jobs associated with a user.

methods.name: signup(req: UserAuthRequest)
methods.description: Endpoint for user registration, creates a new user and issues a token.

methods.name: login(req: UserAuthRequest)
methods.description: Endpoint for user login, authenticates and issues a token.

methods.name: token(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends())
methods.description: OAuth2 token endpoint, issues token based on form credentials.

methods.name: upload_media( file: UploadFile = File(...), current_user=Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Uploads a media file (video/audio) and stores in temporary directory.

methods.name: upload_subtitle( file: UploadFile = File(...), media_id: str = Form(...), language: str = Form(...), current_user=Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Uploads a subtitle file linked to a media ID.

methods.name: sync_subtitle_with_media( media_id: str = Form(...), sub_id: str = Form(...), current_user=Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Performs auto-alignment and validation of subtitles with media, generating a report.

methods.name: get_validation_report(sync_id: str, current_user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves the validation report for a given sync job.

methods.name: get_aligned_subtitle_file(sub_id: str, current_user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Downloads the aligned subtitle file for a subtitle ID.

methods.name: list_user_jobs(current_user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Lists all sync/validation jobs for the current user.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint returning a basic message.

ctags.name: sync_subtitle_with_media
ctags.signature: ( media_id: str = Form(...), sub_id: str = Form(...), current_user=Depends(get_current_user) )

ctags.name: upload_subtitle
ctags.signature: ( file: UploadFile = File(...), media_id: str = Form(...), language: str = Form(...), current_user=Depends(get_current_user), )

fields.name: sync_jobs = {}    # sync_id: {media_id, sub_id, user, status, report}
